clean-grip-deadlift.criteria: Clean-width overhand grip, fixed hip-width feet, long arms, coordinated leg drive with initial trunk angle retained before hip extension. No catch or explosive shrug.

snatch-grip-deadlift.criteria: Wide overhand grip and lower starting position, legs drive first while back angle is retained until passing knees, then hips extend. No catch or explosive shrug.

axle-bar-deadlift.criteria: Thicker cylindrical axle shaft (1.75 times modeled standard diameter, illustrative rather than product replica), double-overhand grip, conventional floor start and controlled return.

limits: Procedural instructional model, not captured human biomechanics. Illustrative equipment proportions and eight-second timing. Overhand grips without detailed hook-grip instruction; no cloth simulation, exhaustive mesh collision or physical-device certification. Production deployment pending.
